Dedicated IP Gateway Resource Get Dedicated IP Gateways Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/dedicatedIPGateways/lite

Retrieves a list of dedicated IP gateways. .

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size

Default value: 250
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

System-generated dedicated IP gateway identifier

name
string

Dedicated IP gateway name

description
string

Additional notes or information about the gateway

primaryDataCenter
object
secondaryDataCenter
object
createTime
int32

Timestamp of when the dedicated IP gateway was created

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp of when the dedicated IP gateway was last modified

lastModifiedBy
object
default
boolean

The gateway that is included by default

]
